messages:
rowan: Quick UX check on the routing rules editor. Users in testing say undo after reordering is too hidden. Current snackbar disappears in 3s and has no keyboard focus. Thoughts?

mei: Agreed. Make snackbar keyboard-focusable and provide Ctrl+Z hook. Also extend visible time to 6s for mouse users, and keep an accessible action: 'Undo (Press Z)'.

tj: If we add Ctrl+Z, be careful with browser conflicts in the console. Scope the shortcut to the editor when it has focus. Announce action with aria-live: 'Reorder undone' or 'Reorder applied'.

ana: Accessibility: when undo appears, set focus to the snackbar only for screen-reader users (aria-hidden false) but don't steal focus for keyboard-only flows. aria-live polite should announce both reorder and undo. Example aria message: 'Moved "Allow internal traffic" to position 2 of 7. Undo available.'

a11y-bot: Reminder: keyboard shortcuts must be documented in the Help menu and be discoverable via a small hint near the list: 'Tip: press Z to undo recent reorder'. Also expose an explicit 'Actions' menu per rule with reorder commands.

rowan: UI notes: make snackbar include a mini diff icon and 'Show change' link to open the preview diff. For the preview, animate only the affected items; keep prefers-reduced-motion respected.

mei: Copy suggestion for the validation toast (instead of 'Invalid order'): 'Ordering blocked \u2014 unresolved dependencies. View dependencies'. That CTA should focus the popover.

tj: Code snippet for aria-live update (pseudo):
```js
liveRegion.textContent = `Moved ${itemName} to position ${to} of ${total}. Undo available.`;
```
Keep it polite.

ana: Also add an explicit aria-label on the drag handle: 'Drag to reorder, press space to pick up'. When using keyboard move, update aria-grabbed and announce start/end positions.

rowan: Thanks. I'll push a Figma update and a tiny canary for the snackbar + diff preview. Can we validate keyboard shortcut scoping tomorrow during the 10min sync?

deploy-bot: Canary live: https://staging.redwood.com/routing/editor/undo-canary

mei: I'll run quick screen-reader checks and post notes here after the sync.
